task.research: Branding ownership already flows `status_pages.title`/`description` through `apps/worker/src/public/status-page.ts` resolvers into public status/homepage payload builders and scheduled fast-guard SQL subselects in `status-refresh.ts` (line ~640) and `homepage.ts` (line ~2190); snapshot freshness compares those values, and page edits already call `enqueueStatusPageRefreshes([id], now, 'page-updated')`. React header in `StatusPage.tsx` renders text-only title/description today; public payload types live in `schemas/public-status.ts` and `apps/web/src/api/types.ts`. task.d1: New append-only migration adds nullable `status_pages.logo_url TEXT`; no backfill, existing rows stay logo-less.

task.d3: `logo_url` is added to public status/homepage payload and stored snapshot schemas, and to the scheduled fast-guard comparison, so logo edits republish page-qualified snapshots even if the refresh queue row is lost.
task.d4: React header shows the image only when present, `alt=""`, `onError` hides it; absent or broken logo renders exactly today's text header.
task.d5: Favicon remains `/favicon.svg`; no upload/base64/R2 in this slice.
task.assumptions: Stored snapshot guard-version handling for a payload-shape change follows the existing pattern from migrations `0011`/`0012`; the executor will locate the exact guard constant during implementation. All existing resolver `SELECT`s in `status-page.ts` enumerate columns explicitly, so each must add `logo_url`.
